work: Quantitative CFTR calnexin (CANX KO) chaperone coupling & single-corrector (VX-661 vs. VX-445) selectivity benchmark reusing the locked residue-clustered split of Tedman et al. 2025 (CC BY 4.0).

claims.statement: Across 167 development variants in Tedman et al. 2025 (234/234 rows aligned between All_variants and All_variants CANX KO, zero excluded), log2(Parental DMSO) and log2(CANX KO DMSO) exhibit Pearson r = 0.992301 (> 0.70 pre-registered positive control).
claims.dataset: sources/downloads/tedman-2025/ALT 9-6-24 CFTR DMS Expanded Library Master Tables.xlsx (CC BY 4.0, DOI 10.17632/ksfmxv8zts.1) summarized in benchmarks/cftr_dms_canx_selectivity/results_2026-11-23.json

methods.name: IEEE-754 float64 dual-sheet XML correlation
methods.difference: parses both workbook sheets with float64 log2 conversion and computes Pearson r in float64 arithmetic

methods.name: Decimal precision independent sheet correlation
methods.difference: separate XML reader computing log2 Pearson correlation via decimal.Decimal without sharing code

claims.statement: On 67 held-out CFTR variants across 59 unexposed codons (zero overlap with dev or PRED-0010), 2-feature OLS predicting log2(Parental VX-661+VX-445) from log2(Parental DMSO) + log2(CANX KO DMSO) yields held-out MAE = 0.430771 log2(Mut/WT) vs. baseline dmso_ols MAE = 0.451487.
claims.dataset: sources/downloads/tedman-2025/ALT 9-6-24 CFTR DMS Expanded Library Master Tables.xlsx (All_variants & All_variants CANX KO, CC BY 4.0) summarized in benchmarks/cftr_dms_canx_selectivity/results_2026-11-23.json

methods.name: Gaussian elimination OLS fit on dual-sheet dev set
methods.difference: solves 3x3 normal equations via partial-pivoting Gaussian elimination

methods.name: Cholesky L L^T 3x3 independent re-derivation
methods.difference: separate XML parser solving 3x3 normal equations via Cholesky factorization

claims.statement: On the same 67 held-out variants in All_variants CANX KO, partial-penalized Ridge (alpha=100.0) predicting dampened single-corrector selectivity S_eps_canx_ko = log2((VX445+0.05)/(VX661+0.05)) yields held-out MAE = 0.189235 vs. dev-CV-locked constant_dev_median MAE = 0.186365 (-1.54%).
claims.dataset: sources/downloads/tedman-2025/ALT 9-6-24 CFTR DMS Expanded Library Master Tables.xlsx (All_variants CANX KO Cols F/J/N, CC BY 4.0) summarized in benchmarks/cftr_dms_canx_selectivity/results_2026-11-23.json

methods.name: Gaussian elimination 10x10 partial Ridge
methods.difference: fits partial-penalized Ridge on All_variants CANX KO via Gaussian elimination

methods.name: Cholesky L L^T 10x10 independent solver
methods.difference: separate XML parser solving 10x10 Ridge normal equations via Cholesky factorization

claims.statement: Pre-registered Arm A hypothesis (>=10% held-out log2 MAE reduction and Bonferroni 97.5% cluster-bootstrap CI > 0 from adding CANX KO DMSO to Parental DMSO) is refuted: point reduction is +4.5884% and 59-cluster 97.5% CI is [-0.001739, 0.044782].

Pre-registered Arm B hypothesis (>=10% held-out MAE reduction and Bonferroni 97.5% cluster-bootstrap CI > 0 for CANX KO single-corrector selectivity S_eps_canx_ko) is refuted: Ridge yields 0.189235 vs. constant_dev_median 0.186365 (-1.5397%, 97.5% CI [-0.038826, 0.036407]).
